text: F1S: fames_fleet._copy_package leaves .fames.previous-<uuid> inside seat skill roots, and Claude loads each one as a separate skill. Measured in ai_cctv: init skills 59 -> 51 after moving 8 copies per surface (.agents/.claude/.cursor; ~2.2k chars of duplicate descriptions plus 8 slash commands every turn). All scar3 seats are affected (ai_scar3/ai_wallpaper/ai_karaoke have 8-9 each). Proposal: retain the backup outside the skills root (e.g. <seat>/runtime/fames-previous/<surface>/), as altos does in park_previous_packages. Evidence: ai_cctv/runtime/fames-previous, scratchpad cctv_stream.jsonl vs cctv_stream2.jsonl. Also: fleet-rogue-scheduler-sweep flags rule text in AGENTS.md and skill copies as repo-schtasks-scripts (ai_cctv=11, none real).
